scope: Only patterns exercised by tests/fixtures/sas/grid and real project fixtures; this is not a complete SAS Grid or scheduler catalog.
change_policy: Add a new pattern id when command semantics or supported forms change; do not broaden an existing form without adding a fixture and parser test.

status_definitions.supported: Fixture syntax is confirmed for a named source version, parser output is tested, and the generated recommendation is checked end to end. No current entry meets this bar.
status_definitions.partial: The pattern is parsed and a conservative recommendation is generated, but syntax/version or downstream equivalence is not confirmed.
status_definitions.unsupported: The occurrence is identified, but its semantics and safe Talend equivalent are unknown; preserve evidence and require manual review.

patterns.description: Submit one SAS program to SAS Grid.
limitations: Fixture labels sasgsub option names illustrative; verify syntax against the target SAS Grid version.
patterns.talend_pattern: Represent each migrated SAS program as a child Job; invoke and pass context only after its implementation is confirmed.
prerequisites: Identify the SAS program and its inputs/outputs.
Define the Talend child Job and its context values.

patterns.description: Parse job name, queue, and wait-for-results flag from a sasgsub command.
limitations: Option spellings in this fixture are illustrative and are not confirmed for any SAS Grid release.
No Talend property is inferred for queue or Grid job name.
patterns.talend_pattern: Preserve ordering explicitly between child Jobs; recreate queue and scheduler settings in the target orchestration platform after confirmation.
prerequisites: Confirm the target scheduler and required execution order.

patterns.description: Options present in the coverage fixture but not interpreted by the current analyzer.
limitations: The analyzer does not parse these spellings or assign them semantics; values remain unclaimed.
prerequisites: Confirm option syntax against the target SAS Grid release and add parser behavior before mapping.

forms: Recognized option without a required following value
patterns.description: Report a known option whose required value is absent.
limitations: An incomplete value cannot be inferred safely; the analyzer leaves it empty.
prerequisites: Provide the missing value and confirm it against the original job definition.

patterns.description: Capture literal parameter values set on the submitted SAS invocation.
limitations: The fixture uses illustrative options; shell expansion and values containing spaces are not fully modeled.
Values are not wired into generated Talend plans.
patterns.talend_pattern: Pass confirmed values as child Job context parameters; never infer unresolved shell or SAS macro values.
prerequisites: Resolve each value at runtime and define matching child Job context parameters.

patterns.description: Recognize a batch SAS invocation and its input program.
limitations: The fixture is synthetic and does not establish support for a specific SAS batch environment.
The migration planner does not consume GridTask records.
patterns.talend_pattern: Implement the program as a Talend Job and pass confirmed parameters through context.
prerequisites: Confirm SAS runtime options, program dependencies, and parameter semantics.

forms: Macro call that resolves a program argument and includes it dynamically
patterns.description: Resolve macro-dispatched SAS programs into ordered child-job candidates.
limitations: Only macros whose included program argument is statically resolvable are expanded.
The fixture does not prove all macro dispatch semantics are preserved.
patterns.talend_pattern: Implement each resolved program as a child Job and pass only confirmed macro parameters as context.
prerequisites: Review macro body, default parameters, dynamic values, and failure handling.

patterns.description: Infer an execution dependency from adjacent recognized commands and a success condition.
limitations: Order is inferred from script order; shell control flow beyond the tested success condition is not modeled.
Inferred dependencies are not emitted in migration plans.
patterns.talend_pattern: Connect confirmed child Jobs with an OnSubjobOk dependency after validating the source control flow.
prerequisites: Review all branches, retries, failure handling, and external scheduler dependencies.

patterns.description: Capture schedule text from SAS or shell file comments; does not parse a Control-M definition.
limitations: Only a comment header is read; calendar, dependencies, resources, and Control-M job definitions are not parsed.
No Talend scheduling recommendation is generated.
patterns.talend_pattern: Recreate and validate the schedule in the organization's chosen scheduler.
prerequisites: Obtain the authoritative scheduler definition and confirm calendars and dependencies.

patterns.description: Identify LSF submission/status commands without interpreting their semantics.
limitations: Commands are detected only; queue, job state, dependencies, and exit semantics are not parsed.
prerequisites: Supply representative scripts and the target LSF version before defining support.
